svg.desc: An A/B test in six steps: hypothesis with one primary metric, power calculation, randomisation by user, sample-ratio-mismatch check, analysis at the randomisation unit, and the decision. Under each step, what goes wrong if it is skipped.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The life of an A/B test

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six steps. Steps 1-4 happen before any result is visible, which is what keeps it honest.
